muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server --output-htmx-template-data-type=AdminTemplateData
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /admin htmx(Admin(ctx))" -}}{{.HXRetarget "#main"}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Admin(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "admin", nil }

// The build only passes if generation produced the renamed htmx template
// data type.
var _ = AdminTemplateData[RoutesReceiver, string]{}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if got, want := rec.Header().Get("HX-Retarget"), "#main"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("HX-Retarget = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
